name: How to Use Pi Coding Agent 1.0: Install, Connect a Model, and Run Your First Task – Kanaries
description: Install Pi 1.0 with one command, sign in with a subscription or API key, or point it at a local Ollama model. Tested on macOS with a local 8B model: real timings, a read-only mode, AGENTS.md loading, and the safety defaults that differ from Claude Code and Codex.
